title: workflow.event.matched payload
description: Payload emitted by the event-trigger loop when an external event matched a workflow's trigger.mode=event filters. Used both as an audit signal and as the dedup key for the dispatcher (one matched record per (workflow_manifest_id, matched_event_id) pair).

workflow_manifest_id.description: id of the workflow manifest that matched

matched_event_id.description: event_id of the source event that triggered the match

matched_event_type.description: type of the matched event, e.g. infra.alert.firing
